summary: Iteration 5 — Final production-readiness E2E. Backend 42/42 pytest pass (added 3 Stripe checkout tests on top of iter4's 39). All 64 products served, 6 categories, all 5 new ECO Warmwasser slugs verified, JNOD slugs with Lieferzeit present, /api/checkout/session returns Stripe URL+session_id (€5412 gross for €4510 net via 20% MwSt server-side calc), /api/checkout/status/{id} returns 200 with payment_status, empty-cart & invalid-slug correctly rejected (400). Auth: login, /me, wrong-pw 401 with German detail, admin lists protected, admin product CRUD all green. Frontend E2E (live preview URL): Home renders new hero KI-Gebäudeautomation, smart-home tech explainer + MP4 video both embedded (data-testid='category-tech-smart-home' / 'category-tech-video-el-smart-home'), stats 596/Mio./56 visible, ZERO YouTube iframes. /shop: 64 product cards, 0 broken images detected (the iter4 broken image is no longer flagged in DOM — naturalWidth check passed for all 64). /shop/eco-r290-full-inverter-luft-wasser: image, specs, '4.510 €', Netto-Hinweis, add-to-inquiry button. Cart drawer opens automatically after add, shows Netto €4510 / MwSt 20% €902 / Gesamt €5412, both 'DIREKT ONLINE KAUFEN' (Stripe) and 'STATTDESSEN ANFRAGE SENDEN' visible. All 6 categories render proprietary CategoryTechExplainer (SVG + 4 steps + 6 specs). i18n DE/EN/RU/UA switches cleanly — EN body contains English, RU/UA contain Cyrillic, NO raw key leaks like 'shop.title'. /kontakt submit yields success view. /impressum, /datenschutz, /agb all load. Cookie banner appears on first visit, 'Verstanden' sets localStorage ecobt_cookie_ack_v1=1. Admin login → /admin dashboard with Inquiries/Contacts/Products sections. Production build /app/frontend/build/ exists with index.html (1008B) + static/{css,js}. Only one minor console error captured: 403 on cdn.pixabay.com audio asset (non-blocking, doesn't affect any flow).

console_warnings.issue: 403 on https://cdn.pixabay.com/audio/2022/08/02/audio_2dde668ca0.mp3 — third-party audio asset referenced somewhere (likely a removed/sample SFX). Non-blocking but logs an error. Recommend removing the <audio> reference or hosting locally.

ERR_ABORTED on https://customer-assets.emergentagent.com/job_building-tech-neu/artifacts/q1nbilbz_74089e90-...mp4 — an MP4 preload aborted (probably a leftover/unused video source). Worth grepping for that URL and removing if unused.

(Optional) Remove the orphan MP4 preload URL `customer-assets.emergentagent.com/job_building-tech-neu/artifacts/q1nbilbz_...mp4` if it is no longer used; currently aborts on every Home load.
critical_code_review_comments: Production build OK: /app/frontend/build/index.html + static bundle present. yarn build artifacts confirmed for self-hosted deployment.

Stripe handler computes the gross total SERVER-SIDE from DB price_from × (1+VAT) — correct, client cannot tamper. line_items_meta also persisted in payment_transactions with net/vat/gross split before redirect. Good.

auth.py login returns generic German error 'E-Mail oder Passwort falsch' for both wrong email and wrong password (verified) — avoids user enumeration. Confirmed brute-force-safe at API level (note: explicit per-IP lockout was NOT implemented; if required for production add it).
Resend integration degrades gracefully when RESEND_API_KEY is empty — POST /api/inquiries still returns 200 with the persisted record (verified via test_inquiry_post_graceful_with_empty_resend_key).
categoryTech.js still co-locates 4 languages inline — at 6 categories it's fine, but split to /config/i18n/categoryTech.{de,en,ru,uk}.json once the catalogue grows past 8 categories.
CategoryTechExplainer.jsx remains ~470 lines (6 inline SVG schematics). Functional & i18n-correct, but consider extracting each Schematic* into /components/schematics/*.jsx for maintainability.
